tool.title: Search the corpus and follow the graph
tool.description: Seed lexically over the authored folio and every declared library, then expand along graph edges, labelling each hit MATCHED or REACHED and by which edge. Counts are split authored vs ingested, and a root that exists but holds no graph nodes is reported rather than read as an empty answer.

inputs.name: query
inputs.description: Words to seed on. Seeding is lexical, so a short phrase works; a long query no node contains seeds nothing.

inputs.name: hops
inputs.description: Expansion depth, 0-4 (default 1). 0 is a plain lexical search.

inputs.name: provenance
inputs.description: `authored` or `ingested`: restricts the seeds, not the expansion.

inputs.name: searchText
inputs.description: Also seed on companion Markdown bodies.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: JSON: summary, emptyRoots, dangling, and hits each carrying a `why`.

$comment.comment:
The knowledge-graph tools. Their handlers lived only in the viewer
server's embedded chat agent, so no MCP client could call them: an agent
session got "Tool corpus_search not found" for the check a folio runs
before declaring anything open (qou bean `qou-q261`). One module, one
registrar, four served names.
